conclusion.confidence_explanation: The confirmation→redemption conversion rate for east/full_service dropped sharply on 08-31 and 09-01 (0.345 and 0.331 vs ~0.69 baseline), while upstream stages stayed stable. However, no activity records exist in the dataset and no mechanism evidence was obtained, so the root cause cannot be established.
requested_data: Activity records (activity_windows) for east/full_service covering 2026-08-31 to 2026-09-01, including any redemption-side incentive or rule changes, to determine whether a redemption-stage event explains the drop.
Any records documenting a mechanism linking a specific event to the confirmation→redemption conversion drop (e.g., redemption channel outage, coupon validity change, merchant acceptance issue).
Control-period comparison for east/full_service confirmation→redemption rate over an equal-length window before 08-31 to confirm the drop is anomalous relative to baseline.
